description: 1. The agent must read SKILL.md to discover `scripts/backup.js` and its CLI flags. 2. The agent must use `--system --workspace` together (NOT `--full`) to produce a combined selective backup — this is the proprietary trap, as the type string 'system-workspace' in the filename/manifest cannot be guessed. 3. The agent must add `--retain 7` to the same command to trigger automatic deletion of old backups (>7 days old) as part of the backup run. 4. The agent may optionally use `--json` for the machine-readable output, but the key artifact is the `.json` manifest file which is always produced alongside the `.tar.gz`. 5. The resulting tar.gz must contain actual openclaw.json/exec-approvals.json (system) and AGENTS.md/SOUL.md/etc. (workspace) files. 6. Pre-seeded old backup files (10, 14, 21, 8 days old) must all be deleted. 7. RECOVERY_GUIDE.md must be generated in the output directory.
